overview_description.description: EyeGo develops advanced AIoT solutions for the hospitality sector, enabling businesses to transform video feeds and operational data into actionable insights. The platform integrates AI-powered cameras, edge computing, cloud analytics, and IoT infrastructure to deliver real-time monitoring, QA inspections, crowd management, people counting, hygiene compliance, and workflow optimization. EyeGo’s solutions are designed for restaurants, hotels, malls, cafés, and other hospitality environments where operational visibility and customer experience are critical. Its technology supports features such as HACCP food safety compliance monitoring, PPE detection, spill detection, occupancy analytics, and live dashboards that work with existing camera systems. The company operates from Saudi Arabia and the UAE and positions itself as a smart hospitality intelligence platform focused on sustainability, automation, and operational excellence.

product.name: EyeGo AI Computer Vision Platform
product.description: An AI-driven computer vision platform that enables machines to interpret and derive insights from visual data to enhance customer experience, increase revenue, and optimize operations.

product.name: Quality and Safety Solution
product.description: A solution that ensures the consistency and safety of services such as fresh food, staff safety compliance, and production through automated inspection.

product.description: A system that uses computer vision to improve customer satisfaction and loyalty by analyzing data, enhancing communication between staff and customers, and offering customized recommendations.

product.name: Operational Efficiency
